said.q: Jarrige envisioned this sculpture as both a response to the architectural space and a reflection of the building’s renewed vitality—its flow of tenants, ideas, and collaborative energy. Hand-sculpted in aluminum, the work captures and reflects ambient light, animating the lobby with a dynamic, luminous presence.

events.n: site-specific; created for the lobby of the former Pfizer building
events.q: Created for the lobby of 630 Flushing Avenue in Brooklyn—the former Pfizer building—Cascade is a site-specific aluminum sculpture by Jacques Jarrige and the first installment of a larger, multi-floor sculptural intervention.
